dependencies.title: Variable dependencies
dependencies.intro: Each variable sits between the requests that set it and the requests that read it. A request sets a variable with an Extract rule or a script, and reads it with {{reference}} in its address, headers, body or auth, or with a script call.
dependencies.showInputs: Show variables that only come from environments
dependencies.missingDetail: These variables are read by a request, but no request sets them and no environment, collection or global list defines them: {{names}}.
dependencies.noneDescription: No request in this scope sets a variable through an Extract rule or a script that another request reads.

command.label: Show variable dependencies
command.description: Draw which requests set and read each variable
command.keywords: graph chain extract flow produce consume
